services.desc: Gulf Coast Party Boats transforms ordinary events into parties to remember forever! Duration 2 hours Rates Person: $59.95 Private Charter: $750 (Monday - Thursday, Friday - Sunday 10am-11am) $850 (Friday - Sunday after 11am) About Gulf Coast Party Boats is a tiki-style party cruise line offering a fun and unique experience for your group or individuals. Our cruises are approximately two hours long and passengers are welcome to bring their own drinks and food on board. More info Though we love our fur-babies, pets/animals are not permitted on board the vessel. There is plenty of free parking available in the grass/gravel lot adjacent to the dock, right by Barge 295. Age Requirements
